Sandbox · Network

Zed's current sandbox documentation says native Zed Agent can use OS-enforced restrictions for terminal and fetch actions, with default project-write, Git-metadata and outbound-network boundaries, while ordinary terminals, External Agents and Terminal Threads are outside that sandbox.

Record limitations

  • All product claims are attributed to Zed Industries public sources; no behavior was observed.
  • No Zed package, Agent thread, model, tool, MCP server or sandbox was installed or run.
  • The stable page pins client version and date but not source revision, package digest or installed architecture.
  • External Agents and Terminal Threads are separate execution paths and do not inherit native Zed Agent claims.
  • Current docs do not prove exact 1.14.2 runtime behavior or configuration.
  • Tool availability, permission outcome and OS sandbox enforcement are separate layers.
  • Publisher privacy statements vary by request path and named provider exceptions.
  • No independent evaluation was attempted for this record and no suitability conclusion is supported.
  • The successor was created from reviewed official sources without installing or running the agent; release identity does not transfer unscoped behaviour claims.
  • No independent evidence, score, ranking, recommendation, safety certification or suitability conclusion was added.

Unresolved unknowns

What the admitted sources do not establish

Unknown does not mean absent. It means the accepted publisher sources do not establish the fact for an effective session.

  1. The installed Zed package, platform architecture, source revision and binary digest are unknown.
  2. The effective native-agent path, thread type and client feature flags are unknown.
  3. The selected profile, custom tools, skills, instructions and MCP servers are unknown.
  4. The effective tool permission defaults, patterns, prompts and user decisions are unknown.
  5. Sandbox enablement, platform dependencies, exceptions and enforcement results are unknown.
  6. The model request path, provider, endpoint, model and inference revision are unknown.
  7. Data retention, feedback opt-in and provider-specific safety-retention applicability are unknown.
  8. Task completion, code quality, security, privacy and independent-evaluation results remain unverified.
